CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    WITH students_h AS (
      SELECT 
        s.full_name AS student_full_name,
        s.department_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(s.email_address)) AS email_full,
        LOWER(CASE WHEN POSITION('@' IN s.email_address) > 0 THEN LEFT(s.email_address, POSITION('@' IN s.email_address)-1) ELSE s.email_address END) AS email_user
      FROM students s
      WHERE UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(s.last_name), 1)) = 'H'
    ),
    dept_phones AS (
      SELECT 
        TRIM(sis_admin_department_name) AS dept_name_key,
        CASE 
          WHEN department_phone_area_code IS NOT NULL AND department_phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN 
            '(' || TRIM(CAST(department_phone_area_code AS VARCHAR)) || ') ' || 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 1, 3) || '-' || 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 4, 4)
          WHEN department_phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 1, 3) || '-' || 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 4, 4)
          ELSE NULL
        END AS department_phone_formatted
      FROM sis_admin_department
    )
    SELECT 
      sh.student_full_name,
      sh.department_name,
      dp.department_phone_formatted,
      0 AS mailing_list_size
    FROM students_h sh
    LEFT JOIN dept_phones dp
      ON LOWER(TRIM(sh.department_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(dp.dept_name_key))
    ORDER BY sh.student_full_name
    LIMIT 5

# Final definitive result: list not found -> empty subscriber set, list size 0

list_info = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT 1
FROM moira_list
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(is_moira_mailing_list)) = 'Y'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name)) = 'beacon-date-date'
LIMIT 1
""")

if list_info.empty:
    db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS student_full_name,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS department_name,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS department_phone_formatted,
           CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS mailing_list_size
    WHERE 1=0
    """)
else:
    # Defensive path (not expected based on prior checks): compute normally
    size_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
    WITH t AS (
      SELECT TRIM(moira_list_key) AS k
      FROM moira_list
      WHERE UPPER(TRIM(is_moira_mailing_list))='Y' AND LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name))='beacon-date-date'
      LIMIT 1
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS list_size
    FROM moira_list_detail d JOIN t ON TRIM(d.moira_list_key)=t.k
    """)
    list_size = int(size_df.loc[0, 'list_size']) if not size_df.empty else 0
    db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, f"""
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    WITH members AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_member)) AS member
      FROM moira_list_detail d
      WHERE TRIM(d.moira_list_key) IN (
        SELECT TRIM(moira_list_key) FROM moira_list WHERE UPPER(TRIM(is_moira_mailing_list))='Y' AND LOWER(TRIM(moira_list_name))='beacon-date-date' LIMIT 1
      )
    ),
    students_h AS (
      SELECT 
        s.full_name AS student_full_name,
        s.department_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(s.email_address)) AS email_full,
        LOWER(CASE WHEN POSITION('@' IN s.email_address) > 0 THEN LEFT(s.email_address, POSITION('@' IN s.email_address)-1) ELSE s.email_address END) AS email_user
      FROM students s
      WHERE UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(s.last_name), 1)) = 'H'
    ),
    dept_phones AS (
      SELECT 
        TRIM(sis_admin_department_name) AS dept_name_key,
        CASE 
          WHEN department_phone_area_code IS NOT NULL AND department_phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN 
            '(' || TRIM(CAST(department_phone_area_code AS VARCHAR)) || ') ' || 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 1, 3) || '-' || 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 4, 4)
          WHEN department_phone_number IS NOT NULL THEN 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 1, 3) || '-' || 
            SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(CAST(department_phone_number AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR), 7, '0'), 4, 4)
          ELSE NULL
        END AS department_phone_formatted
      FROM sis_admin_department
    )
    SELECT 
      sh.student_full_name,
      sh.department_name,
      dp.department_phone_formatted,
      {list_size} AS mailing_list_size
    FROM students_h sh
    LEFT JOIN dept_phones dp
      ON LOWER(TRIM(sh.department_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(dp.dept_name_key))
    JOIN members m
      ON m.member = sh.email_user OR m.member = sh.email_full
    ORDER BY sh.student_full_name
    LIMIT 10
    """)
